archiveTitle: The Royal Purchases of One Lady of the Elven Court

recordPolicy.note: Images are inventoried as source records. Public artwork hosting is not complete. An image/scene is not a purchase, and repeats do not create additional charges.
recordPolicy.sourceDatesAre: Image file creation timestamps, never an in-world purchase date
recordPolicy.paidTotalRule: Sum only non-null cost.paidGold for purchased garments with a verified receipt; no zero placeholders.
recordPolicy.displayOnlyRule: Do not charge display-only or unselected gowns.
recordPolicy.matchingRule: Only explicitly assigned appearance files are grouped; unmatched art remains in the searchable source register.
recordPolicy.publicationRule: Web presentation images are verified GitHub-hosted WebP derivatives; original PNG masters are preserved in a separate Google Drive ZIP. Never imply web derivatives are lossless originals.

costBenchmarks.weeklyShoppingModel: 2–3 Friday gowns, plus one every other Sunday
